g.text: Ambient · AON-1 (Ambient Orbital Node 1) 3U CubeSat · rev A
6061-T6 aluminium, ASTM B211 bar / B209 plate (7075-T73 acceptable), 10 mm [.394] square bar
Hard anodise MIL-A-8625 Type III Class 1, 25-50 µm; dimensions apply AFTER anodise; mask tapped holes
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR X.X ±0.1 [±.004] · X.XX ±0.05 [±.002] · HOLES +0.1/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · THREADS ISO 965 6H · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: FACE A: OUTER FACE NORMAL TO ±Y (1:1) · lower edge = inner edge

g.text: NOTCH (-101 ONLY), SEE END VIEW D
for H1 M2.5 ISO 14581; head flush to 0.05 below the face

svg.text: FACE B: OUTER FACE NORMAL TO ±X (1:1) · lower edge = inner edge

g.text: M3 BORE (-102 ONLY), SEE END VIEW E
for H1 M2.5 ISO 14581; head flush to 0.05 below the face

svg.text: ● = INNER EDGE (corner toward the satellite axis)
NOTCH DEPTH ALONG THE RAIL 6.5 [.256] FROM THE -Z END (FACE A VIEW). Ø0.5 tool corner radius allowed.
Notch is on the inner face that FACE A's holes exit into (the Y-facing inner face).
● = INNER EDGE (corner toward the satellite axis)
● = INNER EDGE (corner toward the satellite axis)
SECTION C-C THROUGH A FACE A HOLE (5:1)
1. Datum A: face A. Datum B: -Z end face. Datum C: face B. Make from 10 mm square 6061-T6 bar; finish all four faces to 8.50 ±0.02 [.3346 ±.0008] AFTER hard anodise
(machine to 8.45-8.47 before anodise; confirm the build-up with the anodiser).
2. Straightness of each face 0.05 [.002] over the full length; ends square to the axis within 0.05; length 340.50 ±0.10 [13.406 ±.004].
3. All four long edges R1.0 [.039] minimum (CubeSat Design Specification rev 14.1, rail edge requirement). Break other edges 0.2 max.
4. Contact faces (both outer faces and both ends): Ra 0.8 µm [32 µin] before anodise, no scratches across the length, no marking. Identify the part on a bag tag
5. Hard anodise all over, Type III Class 1 (undyed), 25-50 µm. Mask the M3 thread (-102). Holes may anodise.
6. Countersinks: H1 head must sit flush to 0.05 [.002] BELOW the face; check every hole with the screw before anodise and re-check after.
7. Deburr all holes inside the rail; no burr may protrude past the inner faces (the frame bar ends seat on them).
8. Inspect per AON-900 T3; record serial, length, 4 faces, straightness on the traveller.
9. All materials on NASA outgassing list: TML < 1.0 %, CVCM < 0.10 % (ASTM E595). No cadmium, zinc or tin plating (whiskers).
